answer.summary: Every test in shard 4 fails because the Spring ApplicationContext never starts. PayloadIdentityRepository.findAllActionIdsByTenantIdWithOlderVersionsInUse has a query that JSqlParser rejects at 'AND', and PayloadIdentityRepository.java is one of the files this change touched. The error is deterministic and tied to the change, so re-running will fail the same way. The 517 errors are cascade failures from the same context load.
